issues: 480×270 设计坐标放大，胶囊只占画面中间一条，21px（×4）字与 30px 图标在成片里仍显小
近黑底 + 紫光，与库里其他暗场紫色 UI 撞色，画面除胶囊外几乎全黑
只有 50f（1.7s），落位、打字、光退挤在一起，没有落定后的 hold
"光退"只发生在胶囊里，环境不跟着变，因果感弱
changes: look 改 sand 午后日光亮场：胶囊背后一轮暖色"太阳"和几团柔光，胶囊用 backdrop-filter 真磨砂把它们晕开
主体放大到 1240×132 胶囊、56px 听写字、92px 圆形声波按钮；材质有白色体积渐变、顶沿高光线、底缘内暗边、暖色两层落地影
光退做满因果：同一个 g 同时熄灭胶囊内赤陶→杏色渐层、背后的暖光、地面反光，声波按钮从实心暖色退成描边中性
时长 50f → 100f：落位 snappy 20f（前 14f 景深收焦）、打字 2f/字匀速 28 字、光退 smooth 62f、尾段 26f hold
画面只加一枚静态品牌小标「Wren · speak or type」，保持全片最安静的一拍
issuesEn: Built on a 480×270 design stage — the pill is a thin strip, and 21px (×4) text and a 30px icon still feel small
Near-black with violet light, clashing with other dark purple UI shots; everything but the pill is black
Only 50f (1.7s): landing, typing and the light fade are crammed together with no settled hold
The light only fades inside the pill; the environment doesn't react, so the cause-and-effect is weak
changesEn: Sand look in afternoon daylight: a warm 'sun' and soft light blobs sit behind the pill, which uses real backdrop-filter frosting to diffuse them
Subject enlarged to a 1240×132 pill, 56px dictation text and a 92px round waveform button, with white volume gradient, top rim highlight, inner bottom shade and a warm two-layer shadow
Full causality: one g value fades the terracotta→apricot inner gradient, the sun behind, the floor bounce and turns the waveform button from solid warm to neutral outline
50f → 100f: snappy 20f landing (14f focus pull), uniform 2f/char typing of 28 chars, smooth 62f light fade, 26f hold
Only one static brand mark 'Wren · speak or type' added, keeping it the quietest beat
